Five principles, one core

What I bring to every team, and where you can see it in my work.

  1. 01

    AI does the busywork. People make the decisions.

    Design to Code
  2. 02

    Count value, not clicks.

    Invia · Offer Box

    Make the customer's next decision obvious.

    Invia · Flex Ticket
  4. 04

    Every design decision should be easy to explain.

    Esports platform

=Core

Honest beats pushy.

"From restaurants to esports stages to booking funnels, I learned the same thing: people decide better when the choice is clear and fair. So I keep the important choices obvious, and I let the test decide."

Not the usual route into design

I started out in restaurants, studied science, and called esports matches live before I moved into UX. Each stop still shows up in how I work: I read people quickly, I trust data over gut feeling, and I explain complex things in plain words.

Today, with six years in UX, I work as a UX/UI and product designer in Berlin, freelance and open to selected roles. I design products across B2B SaaS, travel and gaming, and I build the systems that keep them consistent.
